segments.title: 第65章 士別三日
segments.content:
"Then I'll leave it to you."

After also finishing the song "Waiting For You After Class," Li Luo wrote down the lyrics for both songs and handed them to Yan Zhusheng, then stood up and said.

"It's no trouble." Yan Zhusheng shook her head.

"It's a little past five now." Li Luo glanced at the time and asked, "How about coming to my place for dinner?"

"No need." Yan Zhusheng glanced at him, then looked back at the lyrics in her hand. "An auntie will be coming over to cook soon."

Li Luo recalled, and remembered that was indeed the case.

In his past life, he was a pretty good cook and had successfully taken over the cooking auntie's position, earning a high salary of 15,000 from Yan Zhusheng.

"Alright, then I'll get going." Li Luo walked out of the room to leave, waving his hand. "See you at school tomorrow."

"Okay."

Yan Zhusheng didn't even get up to see him off, completely immersed in the two songs, contemplating how to arrange the music to best fit their style.

To Yan Zhusheng, playing with music was just like playing a game, possessing a unique kind of fun. Once she was immersed in it, it was hard to pull herself away.

Li Luo didn't mind. He walked to the door, changed his shoes, and hailed a cab at the community entrance, heading towards Bihai Lanting.

His phone vibrated on the way. Li Luo took it out and answered, seeing that it was a call from his mom.

"I'm at your place. I'll make you guys something nice tonight," Lin Xiuhong said over the phone. "Where did you run off to?"

"I went to a classmate's house to hang out," Li Luo said. "I'll be back soon."

"Then bring a bottle of vinegar up when you get back," Lin Xiuhong instructed. "You're almost out of vinegar here."

"Okay."

Taking a cab back to the entrance of the Bihai Lanting community, Li Luo got out and bought a bottle of vinegar at the convenience store by the gate. As he came out, he bumped into two familiar figures.

"Li Luo!" Ying Chanxi, who was about to enter the community, saw him and immediately waved and called out.

Li Luo walked over carrying the vinegar, glanced at Qiao Xinyan beside Ying Chanxi, and then asked, "You guys just got back?"

"Auntie Lin called me and asked when I'd be back for dinner," Ying Chanxi said. "And since no one was home at Xinyan's, I brought her over."

"I see." Li Luo nodded and walked into the community.

Just then, Ying Chanxi turned her head and asked him, "Where did you go this afternoon? Did you go play basketball with Zhao Rongjun?"

"Nope, I went to a classmate's house."

"Hm? Which classmate?"

"Yan Zhusheng," Li Luo said. "You know her."

"Huh?" Ying Chanxi was stunned for a moment, then asked with a face full of suspicion, "What were you doing at a girl's house?"

"Oh, you remember that song from before?" Li Luo reminded her. "Yan Zhusheng has a small recording studio at her place, and she knows how to arrange music herself, so I asked her for a favor to record it when I had the time."

"Is-is that so..." Ying Chanxi bit her lip, feeling a little bit displeased. "Didn't I tell you? You could have asked my dad for help."

"Uncle Ying is so busy normally," Li Luo shook his head. "It's better not to bother him with such a small thing. If something difficult comes up, it won't be too late to trouble him then."

"You've already found someone else to help, so what else is there for me to say." Ying Chanxi said, somewhat peeved. She pulled Qiao Xinyan along and walked faster, leaving Li Luo behind.

She can get angry over this?

Li Luo shook his head helplessly, following behind with the bottle of vinegar, and slowly made his way back to 1502.

As soon as he entered the apartment, he heard the sound of stir-frying from the kitchen, along with waves of fragrant aromas.

After changing into slippers, Li Luo walked into the kitchen, placed the vinegar on the counter, and saw that besides Lin Xiuhong, Xu Youyu was also in the kitchen helping out.

"You're back?" Lin Xiuhong glanced at Li Luo, then ordered, "Then you come and help me, let your Senior Sister go rest."

"Auntie Lin, I'll do it." Ying Chanxi walked into the kitchen from outside, naturally took the apron off Xu Youyu, put it on herself, and then pushed her Senior Sister's shoulders towards the door. "Senior Sister, you've worked hard."

"I'm not really tired..." Xu Youyu blinked. By the time she came to her senses, she was already outside the kitchen.

But all she had really done was help wash some vegetables. Turning to look at Ying Chanxi, she found that her coordination with Auntie Lin was indeed much more in sync than her own.

"Does Xixi often help Auntie cook?" Xu Youyu looked at Li Luo, who had also been kicked out, and asked curiously.

"I guess so," Li Luo shrugged his shoulders and said helplessly.

At that moment, the front door opened again, and the voices of Li Guohong and Lin Xiufeng came in from outside.

Li Luo walked to the doorway and took a look, finding the two of them carrying a large, long table, grunting as they moved it inside.

"What are you guys doing?" Li Luo went over to help move the table into the living room, then asked with a puzzled look.

"Your mom had us move it here." Li Guohong patted the tabletop. "A 2.4-meter table. We'll put it in the living room. When you guys usually do homework at home, you can do it together here."

"I have a desk in my bedroom."

"Xixi doesn't," Li Guohong glanced at him. "Besides, when you sit at the desk in your bedroom, you're facing the computer. Who knows if you're even in the mood to do homework."

"...Can't you have a little more trust in your own son?"

"Why are you talking so much?" Li Guohong slapped the table. "Everything's been arranged for you, so don't run your mouth. Have you been behaving well at school? You didn't cause any trouble for the teachers during military training, did you?"

"Dad, I think you should update your assessment of your son in a timely manner." Li Luo wagged his index finger, patted his chest, and said, "Standing before you now is the class president of Class 8, Year 1, you know."

"Huh?" Li Guohong was stunned for a moment. "For real? A kid like you can be class president?"

"Just ask Uncle, he knows."

"Ahem... it's true," Lin Xiufeng said with a laugh. "During the military training, he even had me deliver drinks to his classmates."

"Then why didn't you tell us?" Li Guohong looked at Lin Xiufeng, speechless.

"I just assumed you guys already knew," Lin Xiufeng also looked innocent. "Li Luo never told you he became class president?"

"Oh, come on, for a little thing like this, there's no need to make a special announcement," Li Luo said with a wave of his hand. "A man should stay low-key."

"Low-key my foot!" Lin Xiuhong shouted from the kitchen. "If you've got nothing to do, come in and help bring out the dishes!"

A little past six in the evening, the table of seven began to enjoy dinner.

Upon hearing that Li Luo had been elected class president, Lin Xiuhong was also astonished and couldn't help but look her own son up and down. "You have what it takes to be a class president?"

"...Can you guys have a little more confidence in your son." Li Luo shook his head helplessly. "If you don't believe me, ask Ying Chanxi. I might even be a better class president than her."

"He's alright, I guess." Ying Chanxi glanced at Li Luo, quietly lowered her head to eat, and just gave a perfunctory reply, still sulking about Li Luo going to Yan Zhusheng's house.

It was Qiao Xinyan beside her who said softly, "Li Luo is quite popular at school now. There are even girls who主动give him drinks."

"Oh?" Lin Xiuhong looked at Li Luo. She was bound to have more faith in a student from Class 1 like Qiao Xinyan. "But we should still focus on our studies. Don't you go messing around."

"Don't worry, your son has no interest in puppy love."
